simple.summary: בַּוַּי (Bavvay) means Bavvai , an Israelite First listed occurrence: Neh 3 18.

definitions.full: H942. Bavvai בַּוַּי proper name, masculine a Jew of Nehemiah's time Neh 3:18 = בִּנּוּי 3:24 which probably read also 3:18 ( ᵐ5 Βεδει , Βενει , Βεζερ ); cf, further Sm Listen 12 .
